messages:
maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a cluster of late telemetry for EU region; ~6 hours of events landed after the window. Thinking we should do microbatch handoff for replays to avoid a console surge. Thoughts?

sam: How big is the footprint? any hot tenants?

maya: ~200k events across 3 partitions, spread across ~40 tenants. No single tenant dominates but if we fire full recompute it will flood the backfill queue and make the console churn a nightmare :grimacing:

devon: Can we stagger into small microbatches (5k-10k events) with exponential backoff between shards? That pattern worked for the kv-cache rehydrate last month.

jess: Agree on stagger. Also we should mark these jobs as lower display priority in the Console and ensure they don't trigger the same SLA alerts as customer-facing replays — add a tag so alerting rules ignore them.

sam: +1. Also add a 'replay_hint=partial' metric tag so dashboards can filter them out of aggregate uptimes.

maya: Proposed plan: 1) run a canary microbatch of 5k on eu-a, 2) if canary passes, spin up up to 10 concurrent microbatches capped at 50k total, 3) throttle automatically if per-tenant token-ms crosses threshold.

liam: We can reuse the /api/internal/replay params. Suggest exposing `max_events_per_batch` and `client_priority` so the worker scheduler applies the right slotting. Also add `dedupe_ttl_s` to reduce wasted work on duplicates.

maya: Example call for the canary: ```curl -X POST https://internal.replay/api/v1/replay -d '{"shards":["eu-a"],"max_events_per_batch":5000,"client_priority":"backfill_micro","dedupe_ttl_s":3600}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REPLAY_TOKEN'```

ops-bot: Deploy queued: replay-service v2.4.1 -> canary hosts (eu-01, eu-02) :package:

devon: On the console side we should show a new job type 'microbatch' in the Replays UI so support can mute or collapse them during incidents.

jess: UX note — add a hover tooltip explaining 'microbatch' = staggered small replays for late telemetry, not a full recompute. Prevents PMs from panicking.

sam: I'll add a dashboard panel for per-batch latency, dedupe ratio, and tokens burned. Also will create a temporary alert suppression rule for the next 48h scoped to `client_priority=backfill_micro`.

maya: Starting the canary in 10m. Tagging @eng-sre and @product-observability for visibility :eyes:. Will post results.

liam: I'll also add a cheap pre-check: if dedupe_ratio < 0.9 abort the batch and escalate — that indicates upstream duplicate storms and we shouldn't waste slots.

maya: Thanks — reconvene after canary (eta ~40m).
